description:
Fun.
That’s the sole reason the Moto-Cruiser exists.

We realize it's highly possible that your desire to own one is completely illogical, but also very real. Same same for us. There's just something about a 3-bar frame, a looptail, and 26" wheels that call to a person. It's irresistible.

The Moto-Cruiser is a great choice for around town errands, pump track laps, local singletrack, dumb stunts, or daily wanderings. It’s a good bike for riding around and doing whatever. A simple bike for bike people. A joy-bringer.

Our buddy Kenny took one ride and exclaimed “this bike makes me feel like I have to be home in time for dinner.”

The Moto Cruiser was designed to be as easy to build up as possible from your parts bin or local used bike co-op. It takes rim brakes, 26” quick release or bolt on wheels, and can be built geared or single speed.

We're selling it as a frame, fork, and handlebar bundle, because we think the bar is integral to the experience. We also have options for a geared complete build if you prefer.

Designer's Notes
I've been dreaming of this one for a long time. It's a nod to so many influences…. The klunkers of the mtb pioneers, the untouchable cool of a Cook cruiser, and of course my own beloved 1x1 which has been my main city bike for over a decade. This was a project from the heart.

Looptail, big tire clearance, classic silhouette, derailleur capable horizontal dropouts, and the ability to choose from decades of available used parts, updated with stealth dropper routing and a more progressive geo for maximum playfulness.

I like the idea of providing a new purpose for old parts, so the Moto Cruiser was designed with maximum compatibility and customization in mind. Digging in your community stashes should produce most of the parts to put one together.

In bringing it to market we chose to sell it as a frame, fork, handlebar package because we believe that the tall bar is essential to experiencing this bike as intended, and packaging them all together saves you money vs. buying the bar separately.

In case you were wondering, the name Moto Cruiser is a tribute to Sweetheart Cycles, who originally made a Moto Cruiser model in the early / mid 80’s. Sweetheart later changed their name to Yeti Cycles.
- Jeff

FRAME

Classic “3-bar” silhouette

Looptail design

Canti studs

Bottle mount on down tube

Three pack mounts under down tube

Stealth dropper post routing

Modular cable guides

Clearance for up to 26 x 2.5" tires

FORK

420 axle to crown (suspension corrected for 80mm fork)

Mid-blade rack mount

Tire clearance 26 x 2.5"

HANDLEBAR

90mm Rise

15° Back Sweep

7 ° Up Sweep

830mm Wide

22mm Clamp

100% Butted 4130 Chromoly steel

GEOMETRY
Playful and fun with a tall bottom bracket and short rear end.

TUBING

Wilde Double Tuff
While the Moto-Cruiser uses the same high quality 4130 butted CrMo steel as our TLC frames, it is neither particularly light, nor particularly compliant. Frankly, it’s robust and fairly stiff. It's a full-strength MTB and the tubing is appropriate for the use case.

FRAME SPEC

Clearance for 26 x 2.5" tires

73mm English threaded bottom bracket shell

FORK SPEC

Canti Studs

100mm Spacing

420mm Axle To Crown

1 1/8" Steerer

COMPLETE BIKE BUILD SPEC

Shimano Deore M5100 1x11 Specifications*

Shimano Deore M5100 shifter

Shimano Deore M5100 rear derailleur

Shimano Deore M5100- crankset, 170mm

Shimano Deore M5100 11- 51 cassette

Shimano HG61 11 speed chain

Shimano T-4000 v-brakes

Shimano T-4000 brake levers

FSA Pig DH Pro headset

Sunday Freeze Stem 50mm

Race Face Ride XC seatpost

Delta Axle Rodz locking skewers

WTB Trail Boss 26x2.25" tires

WTB Silverado saddle

Shipped with tubes. But is tubeless ready.

*Subject to change without notice.

If you want a single speed or a full custom build we are happy to build you a bike according to your taste and budget. We work with all the major component suppliers, as well as with many small niche makers. Contact us to get started.

FINISH

Phosphate dipped and E.D. Coated for corrosion resistance and durability. Wet paint finish. Color: Purple Pizazz

DELIVERY/AVAILABILITY

If you're looking for a complete bike send a message. We're reworking the spec a bit due to parts availability.

Some bike models are built up and ready to ship, while others are built to order. Contact us if you have questions on delivery. We aim to ship your bike ASAP.

SAFETY

Please read the bicycle owners manual before riding. This is important for safe operation of your new bike.
Bicycle Owners Manual
